page0.text:
The lethal weapons cross.
The twin swords and the spear repeatedly attack, trying to take each other's necks.
Those attacks are continuous, without hesitation.
Every blow that is released is meant to kill.

page1.text:
Lancer is not an exception.
Even though he told Rin Tohsaka, his ally, that he would take it easy, that becomes secondary once the battle starts.
It merely means that if his spear happens to miss Archer's heart and it does not kill him instantly, then he won't finish him off.
Even in that case, his enemy will die, but Lancer would just need to drag Archer to Rin Tohsaka before he does.
Lancer does not care what happens after that.

page2.text:
"Ungh!"
The crimson demonic spear invades the enemy's territory.
The spear breaks through Archer's defense each time it is thrust.
It is different from the battle from before.
Archer cannot handle Lancer's attacks that he was able to dodge that night.

page3.text:
It is only natural.
This is the second battle.
Lancer was bound by a certain Command Spell.
To learn his enemy Master's strengths, his Master told Lancer,
"Fight with everyone. But do not defeat them. Survive the battle against someone you are fighting against for the first time no matter what."
That is the only command he was given.
He obeyed such a ridiculous command, and his "no-holds-barred battle" had finally come.

page4.text:
Therefore, there is no way that it is the same as the last battle.
There is nothing binding Lancer, and Archer is now fighting the fastest Heroic Spirit out of all the Servants.

page5.text:
"Hnng...!"
Anguish escapes from Archer for a second time.
Even his hawk-like eyes cannot follow Lancer's spear.
The spear's trajectory is no more than a point to start with.
That was changing into a flash of light now.
He cannot see the tip of the spear closing in on him.
Even the movements of Lancer's arms and legs are speeding up to reach the realm that is no longer visible.

page6.text:
"Ugh..."
He was able to dodge this much because he knew Lancer's spear from the last battle.
He is doing what he can now... Using the fact that he is inferior to Lancer when it comes to hand-to-hand combat as a weapon to handle his fierce attacks.
He is adjusting where he gets attacked.
The knight in a red cloak limits the attacks by creating fatal openings himself.

page7.text:
Of course, he will die if he does not dodge these attacks.
But, if he is going to die getting wounds all over his body from trying to avoid an instant death, he'd rather die an instant death with all limbs intact.
Otherwise, it will all have been for nothing.
Fortunately, Lancer is still underestimating Archer.
No, he is simply immersed in the battle itself.
If they are going to keep on killing each other with just a difference in ability, then he can think of another thirty ways of showing openings.

page8.text:
Predicting the enemy's movements using information gained previously, and breaking the status quo from cultivated battle experience.
That is the mind of steel called the "mind's eye" that is gained from training.
This is nothing deemed as extraordinary.
This is the only skill that he possesses.
It is not innate like Saber's instinct, but it is a simple weapon that anyone can gain from training in a frank manner.

page9.text:
...
Lancer withdraws his spear and stops for a bit.
He observes the disgruntled bowman in red.

page10.text:
It is obvious who is going to win.
Archer has no chance of victory at hand-to-hand combat.
That is something he knew.
If Archer is a bowman like his name states, this cannot be a fair fight unless he is shooting from a distance.
But, he blocked the attacks.
He has been at an advantage and should not last a few more blows, but he blocked my full-force attacks.

page11.text:
Is he strong, or am I going easy on him?
I sneer.
Archer is a mysterious Servant.
I should admit that he's strong in that regard.

page12.text:
But... It is unthinkable that I'm going easy.
The first attack was aimed at the neck to blow his face off.
The second attack was aimed at the heart to smash his rib cage.
There's no way I'm going easy.
There's no way, but...
It is certainly true that I wasn't trying to kill him.

page13.text:
What is there in a serious battle?
A battle between Servants comes down to a battle of Noble Phantasms.
The fact that I'm cornering him without using that fatal attack is proof that I'm going easy.
That reason...
The cause seems to be the expression of gratitude that he had never heard before.
"...Damn. Geez, am I being serious...!?"

page14.text:
"Khh...!"
"Guh...!"
The swords clash harder than before.
Both parties spring apart with sparks that fly.
Lancer's full-force blow, as if he is about to hit himself, is offset by Archer's full-force attack.

page15.text:
The distance between them is about five meters.
With that distance, Lancer would be able to close in at an instant…
"...I don't get it."
The spearman in blue murmurs.

page16.text:
"You went under Caster even though you are this strong? You and Rin would be able to defeat Caster."
Lancer stops emitting murderous intent, but there is no opening in his stance.
At that, Archer slightly smiles.

page17.text:
"...I'm surprised. I was wondering what you were going to say, but you are still saying such things?
Lancer, I chose the option that has the highest possible chance of victory. No matter what Rin thinks, I decided that there is no other option than this."
His voice, full of confidence, has no sense of guilt.
The knight in red actually did not regret betraying his Master.

page18.text:
"Is that so? It was stupid of me to even ask."
Archer agrees.
Lancer snorts and quietly raises the tip of his spear.

page19.text:
"You are certainly good at fighting. You should be able to manage well with the path you chose.
But, that is not the right way. Your sword definitively lacks pride."
His fighting spirit rises.
Seeing that, the bowman in red smiles in delight.

page20.text:
"Yeah, unfortunately, I don't have any pride.
But what about it? Will my name as a hero be disgraced? Hah, don't make me laugh, Lancer. I can wash off disgrace with results.
You can feed your meaningless pride to the dogs."
...
In an instant.
The slightly relaxed atmosphere completely changes.

page21.text:
The air freezes.
The demonic spear, with the magical energy to disrupt the order of the world and invert cause and effect, is raised.

page22.text:
The murderous intent that is released is nothing like before.
In the midst of the tension where it is difficult to even breathe...
"You said 'dogs,' Archer?"
The spearman in blue bellows in a voice that could drive crows away from the battlefield.

page23.text:
"It's the truth, Cú Chulainn. If you have pride as a hero, you should get rid of it right now."
"...Well said. Then, you die first."

page24.text:
Lancer jumps back greatly.
It is not the matter of distance to thrust his spear.
The distance that opened between them in an instant is over 100 meters.
Lancer leaps back to the entrance of this clearing and crouches on all fours like a beast.

page25.text:
...
Archer's five senses freeze.
Is it fear or awe?
Whichever it is, he immediately understood.
The meaning of Lancer's retreat.
The fact that his enemy's next attack is literally a fatal attack.

page26.text:
"You know about Gáe Bolg's ability, right, Archer?"
Lancer, crouching on the ground on all fours, raises his waist.
His form is like a sprinter waiting for the starting pistol.

page27.text:
...
Archer does not have the time to answer.
The knight in red throws away his swords and immerses himself in his own mind as fast as possible.
But will he make it?
Lancer's posture...
If his demonic spear is like the legend, the Noble Phantasm that blocks it cannot be superficial.

page28.text:
"...Here I come. Take this attack as a farewell present...!"
The blue panther runs.
Even his afterimage is far away. Lancer sprints towards Archer like the wind.

page29.text:
The distance between both parties is 100 meters.
Lancer is not going to thrust his spear with that running start.
The blue figure crouches.
The spearman that ran through fifty meters in an instant suddenly leaps up from the ground.

page30.text:
His body flies through the air.
He holds up the magical spear that "always pierces the heart once it is thrust."
Space distorts.
According to the legend...
That spear scatters numerous arrowheads once it is thrust into the enemy.
In other words...

page31.text:
"Gáe (Soaring Spear that)..."
The spear of causality respond to the words.
The spearman in blue leans back as if drawing a bow,
"Bolg (Plunges with Death)!!!!!"
and he slams down that blow with a roar.

page32.text:
It is a Noble Phantasm that was made to be thrown.
The spear that always pierces the heart once it is aimed.
The cursed Noble Phantasm that cannot be avoided and will continue attacking the target every time it is avoided.
That is Gáe Bolg, the spear of destruction possessed by the hero who never lost once in his lifetime.
There is no way to stop the thing that is shot out with all of Lancer's magical energy. It cannot be avoided nor dodged.

page33.text:
Therefore, it is fatal.
There is no way for one to survive once they are targeted by the magical spear...!

page34.text:
The magical bullet approaches.
In a split second, the knight in red closes his eyes as if accepting his death...

page35.text: "I am the bone of my sword."

page36.text:
The thorn of light clashes.
The moment the thorn of destruction comes falling from the sky to directly hit the knight in red...
"Rho Aias (Seven Rings Cradling the Burning Heavens)!"
The True Name is spoken, shaking the air.

page37.text:
The spear and shield clash.
The spear of death which breaks through every protective wall and evasion...
That spear is stopped.
The fatal spear is stopped by Archer's Noble Phantasm, swirling up a storm of wind and scattering debris.
The seven flower petals that appeared from somewhere protect Archer and oppose the magical bullet that tries to shoot him down...!
Who would know?
This protection itself is Aias. The only thing said to have stopped the javelin of the great hero is the shield of Aias.
There are seven barriers shaped like flower petals, and each layer is as strong as a castle wall.
It is a Bounded Field Noble Phantasm that is invincible against any projectile weapon targeted towards the user.

page38.text:
A thrown spear would surely be defeated by the shield without penetrating even one of the petals.
At the very least, Archer does not know of any spear that can break through this shield.

page39.text:
And yet...
That fatal spear breaks through it effortlessly.

page40.text:
"...Guh...!!!!!"
The sixth flower petal is destroyed.
Only one remains.
The magical spear reaches the seventh petal that has never been pierced through and doesn't stop its force.

page41.text:
The unstoppable thorn of the magical spear.
With that right in front of him...
"NU... NUAAAAAAAAA...!!!!"
With a roaring spirit, Archer pours all of his magical energy into his own Noble Phantasm...!

page42.text:
...
Lancer, who has landed on the ground, stares at the Servant in front of him.
...Archer has wounds all over his body.
His stretched out arm is like a decayed branch.
His face is distorted in pain, not only from the wounds on his arm, but from enduring a headache beyond his imagination.

page43.text:
"...I'm surprised. I did not think there was a spear in this world that could penetrate Aias.
Your spear surpasses the original Gungnir."
The knight in red compliments the spearman in blue from the bottom of his heart.

page44.text:
...
There is no way such a thing would get through to Lancer.
His strongest attack.
The attack that made him a hero was blocked.
He is so angry that his glare should be able to kill someone.

page45.text:
But, that anger is almost erased by a strong wonder.
...It is too strange.
It is true that Archer is a mysterious Servant.
His identity is unknown, he carries twin swords while being a bowman, and even showed a shield that could block Lancer's strongest attack.
That is abnormal.
Such a hero cannot be found anywhere in this world.

page46.text:
"Who are you...?"
"I'm just a bowman. Your judgment is not incorrect."
"Nonsense. A bowman would not have a shield that could block a Noble Phantasm."
"It depends.
But, this is the result. I used up most of my magical energy, one of my arms is destroyed, and Aias is completely shattered.
...Geez, that was my strongest protection."

page47.text:
...
Lancer keeps glaring at Archer, who is bantering.
Then...
"More importantly, have you noticed, Lancer?
Caster seems to be unexpectedly struggling. She is no longer supervising us."
Archer adds, raising his arms as if to surrender.

page48.text:
"...I see. I thought so. So that was your intention from the start."
"Of course. I told you, right? That I would only choose the option with the highest success rate."
"...Heh. I really hate you."

page49.text:
Lancer says bitterly and turns his back to Archer.
...His job is done.
His role to distract Archer is meaningless now.
There is no need for him to support Rin Tohsaka any longer.
